summary: A threading.Thread that is not daemonised, joined (function-local for source; module-wide for tests), or owned by a class with __enter__ and __exit__ fails the build. Source scope by default; suppress with a reasoned # thread-ok marker.
changelog: - New gate `thread_lifecycle` (hard, no advisory mode, source scope by default): a non-daemon `threading.Thread` must have `daemon=True`, a join or `.daemon = True` on its object (function-local in source, module-wide in tests), or a context-manager owner. List-built threads joined in a loop are accepted. Suppress with `# thread-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for thread_lifecycle to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).

The measured corpora are the source trees only, as the default scope requires; the first measurement's four hits (three mlframe benchmark thread lists, one pyutilz benchmark thread list) were false positives of the list-then-join pattern, fixed in the gate and covered by a test.
